items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I remember trombones being in the band then. ... we always called him Long Charlie. ... he was a vowel trombone player.

ctx.x: Have trombones in the band then?
Well, I remember trombones being in the band then. I just remember his right name, but we always called him Long Charlie. Long Charlie. Yeah, he was a vowel trombone player.
Well, how did they play that vowel trombone?
